title: Sukiselkie's SMP Pack++
description: Some QoL mods in a pack for Sukiselkie's SMP.
body:
It's that time!

Sukiselkie's "BitchesVillages" SMP is releasing soon, on Saturday. 
Best be prepared with an optimal pack that suits it best.

The bare minimum to join is in here of course, but I have thrown in some extra goodie goodie mods:
- AppleSkin: Lets you view your saturation, and shows you how much hunger you'll get when you eat an item.
- Iris: Shaders! I'm not shipping a Shader Pack in the modpack for now, but you best bet I'm putting in there for the hell of it.
- NotEnoughAnimations: Gives you a ton of new client side animations. Very nice in combination with Flashback.
- Flashback: Yes, you heard that right. I'm shipping Flashback- The mod that lets you record your gameplay and make cinematics with it. 
- Roughly Enough Items: A classic recipe viewer mod. Can't go wrong with it!
- Xaero's Minimap: Waypoints, and a map! Dora would be proud.. Don't worry, I've disabled the cheaty features by default. No more radar, no more Cave Mode.
- Fabrishot: Take massive screenshots, because why not? 4K 4 Me.
- Continuity: Adds connected texture support. Not much else to say.

The rest of the mods are dependency mods, so please don't delete them unless you delete the mods that depend on them.
